newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Philippine H1 1997 approved investments up sharply.
newsitem.headline: Philippine H1 1997 approved investments up sharply.

text.p: The Philippines' Board of Investments (BOI) said on Friday it approved projects worth 199.53 billion pesos for the first six months of the year, 153 percent higher from 78.97 billion in the year-earlier period.
"Investment growth was impressive on all counts: project cost, equity investments and employment generation," the BOI said in a statement.
Most of the investments for the first half of the year were in energy related projects amounting to 68.41 billion pesos followed by the infrastructure service sector at 53.16 billion pesos.
For June alone, the government agency said approved projects worth 22.15 billion pesos.
The BOI-approved projects are entitled to income tax holidays and minimum duty on imported capital equipment.
